ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee; close the rider's dispute with an explanation that the driver tapped "I'm Here" at the pickup point and waited beyond 3 minutes before cancelling.
ruling.reasoning:
Screening: the chat is purely operational (arrival notice and notice of cancellation of a no-show) — no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation, and the dispute type is no_show, not safety. safety_concern = none.

Cancellation-fee branch (NS-0): driver cancelled and asserted rider no-show → NS-1 governs.

NS-1 (i) arrival confirmation: the driver's "I'm Here" tap is recorded on the timeline at 17:19:15 [F6], corroborated by his chat at 17:19 ("I'm here at the pickup point") [F9]. The record shows a driver_tap, not a platform auto-confirmation; the platform's own arrival record at 17:17:50 [F5] is listed separately and is not treated as the tap.

NS-1 (ii) location at tap: at the moment of the tap the driver was 41 m from the pickup point [F6], well within the 200 m parameter, and his closest approach was 35 m [F1]. Satisfied.

NS-1 (iii) continuous wait of more than 3 minutes after the tap: after tapping at 17:19:15 he remained within 200 m for 3 min 40 s [F6], the cancellation occurred at 17:22:55 [F4] and the vehicle was stationary in the same spot from 17:18:50 to 17:22:55 [F3] — roughly 3 min 40 s in-range after the tap, which exceeds the 3:01 requirement (">3 min"). The driver's chat "3 min up, cancelling the trip" at 17:22 [F10] matches the timeline. No GPS gap is indicated (sampling continuous through the cancellation moment).

All three conditions are met, so the $6.61 cancellation fee stands (driver's $4.50 share is internal to Ryde), i.e. no_action on the rider's dispute. The rider's "I came out a minute after the driver cancelled" is a statement (complaint) and cannot override the system gps/timeline record of 5 min 5 s in-range and 3 min 40 s waited after the tap [F2][F5][F6].

Other clauses: no waiting-fee dispute (NS-6 not triggered); no fare add-ons (FARE-1 not triggered); the driver's 90-day profile shows 2 upheld no-show disputes [F17] but NS-2 flag_account requires an NS-1 failure — none here, and RD-6 applies only to route-deviation outcomes; profile facts cannot decide a case alone. F4's "6 min 55 s after acceptance" is irrelevant because the acceptance-clock only matters for rider-side cancellations (NS-4).

rejected_claims.reason: Rider says she came out a minute after the cancellation, but this is a statement that conflicts with the system records: GPS shows the driver within 200 m of the pickup for 5 min 5 s cumulative [F2], stationary 17:18:50–17:22:55 [F3], and in-range for 3 min 40 s after his 17:19:15 "I'm Here" tap [F6]; the system record prevails. NS-1 (i)–(iii) are all satisfied and the waiting time after the tap exceeds 3 minutes.
